project.name: nablatensor-engine-wgpu
project.description: Everything wgpu: the java.lang.foreign runtime binding wgpu-native's C ABI (webgpu.h) — instance/adapter/device bring-up, a WGSL compute pipeline per tape, and a replay engine that mirrors the Vulkan one line-for-line, generating WGSL instead of GLSL. No JNI, no native jar; the prebuilt libwgpu_native shared library is located at runtime the same way libvulkan/libshaderc are. Single precision. Gates at runtime.
